data.narrative:
Vyriy Drone is a Growth-stage company in the Defense & Security sector founded by Oleksiy Babenko. The valuation universe comprises 10 peer companies: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic. The company has raised $4M+ in M&A activity as of 2025.

Valuation was conducted using stage-progression methodology, the sole applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. Starting from the $4M total raised as a proxy baseline, a 1.2x step-up multiplier was applied to reflect typical Growth-stage advancement, yielding an implied value of $5M. The peer-median approach could not be deployed: while 26 same-sector Defense & Security peers exist in the available dataset, none yielded a sufficient narrow cohort (minimum 3 required) when filtered by stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable bias.

The analysis triangulates to a median valuation of $5M, with a range of $4M (low) to $6M (high). This reflects modest upside from initial capitalization consistent with Growth-stage risk and runway. Key uncertainties center on the absence of comparable transaction multiples or revenue metrics for same-stage Defense & Security peers, limiting validation of the stage-progression multiplier. A more robust conclusion would require revenue data, customer traction, or access to narrower peer multiples in the defense drone subsector.
